description: This Java class 'Metrics' manages and tracks various metrics related to the MockServer, including counters for requests, actions, WebSocket events, and other operational data, using Prometheus Gauge objects.

classes.name: Metrics
classes.description: A class for collecting and managing various operational metrics for MockServer, including counters for requests, responses, actions, and WebSocket events.

methods.name: Metrics
methods.description: Constructor that initializes metrics based on configuration and registers build info collector if metrics are enabled.

methods.name: getOrCreate
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a Gauge metric by name, with synchronized access to ensure thread safety.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets a specific metric identified by name to zero.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a specific metric to a given integer value.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of a specific metric.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Increments a specific metric by one.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Increments a metric based on Action.Type enumeration.

methods.name: decrement
methods.description: Decrements a specific metric by one.

methods.name: decrement
methods.description: Decrements a metric based on Action.Type enumeration.

methods.name: clearRequestAndExpectationMetrics
methods.description: Clears metrics related to requests and expectations.
